$schema.description: JSON Schema path or URL for editor validation and hover docs

allowUnsafe.description: Report unsafe build patterns (like ParseErrors or late configure() imports) as warnings instead of failing the build

bakedLimit.description: Maximum total characters of baked introspection metadata allowed per precompiled site (default 1 MB)

checker.description: TypeScript checker used by `ark declare`: 'tsjs' (TS 5.5-6), 'tsgo' (TS 7 native), or 'tsrs'

conditions.description: Package export conditions used when resolving imports during precompilation

config.description: Path to the module that calls configure(), or false to forbid configure() calls

creationChecks.description: Runtime checks emitted when validators are created: 'types' (default), 'helpers' (tests), or 'none' (production)

dependencies.description: How to handle dependencies that import arktype without opting in: 'aot' to precompile or 'arktype' to run on arktype

droppedNarrow.description: Warn when structural operations ('...', .merge(), .pick(), .omit(), .partial(), .required(), .map()) drop a root .narrow() predicate (default true)

errors.description: Error reporting mode for standalone validators: 'all' (default), 'first', or 'none'

freeze.description: Freeze precompiled validators and their members (default true in development, false in production)

jsonInput.description: Trust objects validated with rejected undeclared keys to be plain JSON-like objects so key counts can be used

lazy.description: Create validators lazily on first read instead of eagerly at module load (default true, false under 'smallest')

description.description: Bake .description onto standalone validators (auto-detected when unset)

expression.description: Bake .expression onto standalone validators (auto-detected when unset)

json.description: Bake .json onto standalone validators (auto-detected when unset)

methods.description: Keep .traverse(), .from(), and .toString() on standalone validators (default true)

toJSON.description: Bake .toJSON() onto standalone validators (auto-detected when unset)

toJsonSchema.description: Bake .toJsonSchema() onto standalone validators (auto-detected when unset)

~standard.description: Keep the Standard Schema '~standard' property on standalone validators (default true)

~standard.jsonSchema.description: Bake Standard JSON Schema support onto '~standard.jsonSchema' (auto-detected when unset)

members.description: Control which properties and introspection helpers are kept on standalone validators

mutatesInput.description: Allow morphs and defaults to mutate input in place: false (default), true, or 'always'

optimize.description: Optimize generated validators for 'speed' (default, compiled per Type) or 'size' (shared runtime checkers)

optimizeErrors.description: Optimize generated error paths for 'speed' or 'size' (defaults to optimize)

preset.description: Named preset of defaults: 'smallest' minimizes bundle size, 'introspectable' keeps all introspection members

prune.description: Prune unused validator members in production bundles (default true where supported)

runtime.description: Set to 'arktype' to ship arktype's runtime parser alongside precompiled validators

schemas.description: Map module paths, globs, or 'path#Declaration' keys to a strategy name ('fastest', 'smallest', or custom)

shadow.description: Run both precompiled validators and dynamic arktype in tests and fail wherever they disagree

strategies.description: Define named optimization strategies referenced by 'schemas' or '// @ark-strategy' comments

optimize.description: Optimize validators using this strategy for 'speed' or 'size'

tsconfig.description: Path to the tsconfig.json whose paths and program settings the build uses
